title: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to crush, grind, or polish materials, such as coal, glass, grain, stone, food, or rubber.

projection.title: Crushing, grinding, and polishing machine setters, operators, and tenders

tasks.text: Observe operation of equipment to ensure continuity of flow, safety, and efficient operation, and to detect malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Clean, adjust, and maintain equipment, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Tend accessory equipment, such as pumps and conveyors, to move materials or ingredients through production processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pumping systems operated and adjusted in field

dwas.name: Operate pumping systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Move controls to start, stop, or adjust machinery and equipment that crushes, grinds, polishes, or blends materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Notify supervisors of needed repairs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Weigh or measure materials, ingredients, or products at specified intervals to ensure conformance to requirements.

tasks.text: Reject defective products and readjust equipment to eliminate problems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material quality often needs hands-on or visual inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of materials or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Inspect chains, belts, or scrolls for signs of wear.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Clean work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.
